🔥 बॉस! Diwali 2026 पर रिलीज होने वाली निर्देशक Nitesh Tiwari की फिल्म Ramayana ने तो रिलीज से 9 दिन पहले ही बॉक्स ऑफिस पर तहलका मचा दिया है!

🎬 27 October दोपहर 3 बजे तक के डेटा के मुताबिक, Ranbir Kapoor, Yash और Sai Pallavi स्टारर इस फिल्म के भारत में 5,780 शोज़ में 1.96 लाख टिकट्स बिक चुके हैं. Namit Malhotra और Yash के Monster Mind Creations बैनर तले बनी इस फिल्म ने 10.74 crore Gross (9.10 crore Net) कलेक्शन कर लिया है.

🚀 इस जबरदस्त रिस्पॉन्स के साथ Ramayana ने Mirzapur: The Movie (9.19 crore) को पछाड़कर 2026 की 4th Biggest Pre-Sales का रिकॉर्ड बना लिया है! अब इसका अगला टारगेट Sunny Deol की Border 2 (12.50 crore) है, जबकि लिस्ट में Dhurandhar 2 और Drishyam 3 भी आगे हैं.

💥 पिछले 24 घंटे में बुकिंग में 11.18% की बढ़त दर्ज हुई है और Hyderabad व Ahmedabad मिलाकर 11 शोज़ Houseful हो चुके हैं. कमाई में Delhi-NCR 2 crore Gross के साथ टॉप पर है, वहीं Bengaluru ने Mumbai को पीछे छोड़ दिया है.

क्या आपको लगता है कि 5 November को रिलीज होने पर Ramayana एडवांस बुकिंग के सारे रिकॉर्ड तोड़ देगी? कमेंट्स में बताएं!👇

ctx.title: Ramayana Box Office Day 1 Advance Booking (9 Days To Go): With 1.96 Lakh Sold Tickets, Already The 4th Biggest Pre-Sales For Bollywood In 2026!
ctx.summary:
Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi's Ramayana is looking at great opening day numbers as it stays strong with its pre-sales - day 1 advance booking report. 
 The post  Ramayana Box Office Day 1 Advance Booking (9 Days To Go): With 1.96 Lakh Sold Tickets, Already The 4th Biggest Pre-Sales For Bollywood In 2026!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
The pre-release momentum for Indian cinema’s biggest cinematic spectacle, Ramayana, has entered double-digit territory! With exactly 9 days remaining before its historic worldwide release on November 5 (Diwali 2026), director Nitesh Tiwari’s magnum opus starring Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi is pulling off good pre-sales at the ticket windows.
As of October 27, 3 PM, the mythological epic has officially crossed a gross collection of 10.74 crore, with an almost 9.10 crore net collection from Day 1 advance bookings (excluding blocked seats). Having sold a staggering 1.96 lakh tickets across 5,780 tracked shows in India, the devotional mythological epic is growing every single day!
Ramayana has officially surpassed Mirzapur: The Movie (9.19 crore) to claim the 4th Biggest Opening Day Pre-Sales for a Bollywood Film in 2026! It now stands below Dhurandhar 2, Drishyam 3, and Border 2. Hopefully, with 9 days in hand, the film will take big leaps with a full-fledged opening for advance bookings!
Produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations, the film has already booked 11 houseful shows. Out of them, 8 are in Hyderabad, 2 in Ahmedabad. In the last 24 hours, the film has registered 11.18% growth in its advance bookings for the opening show!
By storming past Mirzapur: The Movie ( 9.19 crore ) on Day 9 of pre-sales tracking, Ramayana now sits comfortably in the top 4 of the year, with Sunny Deol ‘s Border 2 ( 12.50 crore ) as the next target! Delhi-NCR continues to reign supreme as the top-grossing territory, while Bengaluru maintains its remarkable edge over Mumbai. Delhi has already crossed the 2 crore gross mark with its advance sales for day 1.
